questions.question: What does Proverbs 15 say turns away wrath?
Where are the eyes of the LORD, according to Proverbs 15?
options: Nowhere at all, far removed from all human affairs
In heaven only, and never once down upon the earth
Upon the kings and the great rulers of the earth alone
In every place, keeping watch on the evil and the good
questions.answer: In every place, keeping watch on the evil and the good
